name: Corporate Action General Information SD 56
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action general information details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: Xpath to the element that is being extended.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) native corporate action event type name. Used in place for the events that cannot be classified by ISO Code and are marked as OTHR. Can be used in combination with DTCC sub event type (when provided) to identify the event. For an example: a distribution based on recapitalisation event will be presented as event type: OTHR in standard message. DTCC native event type would be Distribution (DIST) and DTCC sub event type would be Recapitalisation.

SubEventType.name: Sub Event Type
SubEventType.definition: DTCC (The Depository Trust and Clearing Corporation) corporate action sub event type name further defines the event type. For an example: a cash dividend event eligible for dividend reinvestment at DTC election will be noted as event type: cash dividend (DVCA) and DTCC sub event type: DRIP( DTC only).

EventGroup.name: Event Group
EventGroup.definition: DTC processing domain/ category for event types.
